remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive. Pictured in 1924 New York (Anderson) and 1934 New York (An American Place) Stieglitz installation photographs, see Appendix III, figures 24, 56. Titled *Red Lines* 1923 by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Red Lines

description: Two narrow, dark red lines run lengthwise down the center of the composition. On either side of the image, three overlapping, thin white forms frame the red lines, curling inward on themselves at the top. The white forms resemble the petals of a flower.
imageCaption: Image has not been color proofed to current standards, and its colors may differ from the original work. The Museum will replace it when new photography becomes available.
